ja.title: Inavolisibの腎機能別用量をAUCとピーク・トラフから考える
ja.seo_title: Inavolisibの腎機能別用量とPK | Daiki Kumakura
ja.summary: 公表3コンパートメントモデルと腎機能試験のAUC比で、用量補正と同一日量の分割を比較。4096組の条件付き解析からピーク・トラフの違いと臨床予測の限界を整理する。

en.title: Inavolisib renal dosing: AUC, peaks and troughs
en.summary: Published inavolisib PK separates renal dose adjustment, AUC matching and concentration shape without predicting clinical benefit.
en.seo_title: Inavolisib renal dosing: AUC, peaks and troughs
en.seo_description: Published inavolisib PK separates renal dose adjustment, AUC matching and concentration shape without predicting clinical benefit.

english.title: Inavolisib renal dosing: AUC, peaks and troughs
english.summary: Public three-compartment PK and aggregate renal study ratios support conditional exposure comparisons. Equal daily dose does not imply equal peaks or troughs; clinical benefit is not predicted.
